evidence: Music runs wall-to-wall and the voice is sung (sustained-pitch ratio 0.75): looks like a song with vocals / music video, so an AI song is likely (no VLM; music-video prior, down-weighted)
The music is hard-cut at the end (still at full level when the video stops): typical of a trimmed existing track
how_to_confirm: Check the music tag on the original Douyin / Xiaohongshu / TikTok post: a song title → existing track; "original sound - @creator" → uploaded by the creator (for music videos, usually an AI song)
Run it through Shazam / ACRCloud or another song-ID service: a hit means an existing song
Listen: AI songs tend to have mushy diction, a thin metallic top end and lyrics that track the picture; library beds are mostly instrumental, standard in structure, and truncated or faded at the end

evidence: Voice and background sound run across cuts: the voice-over was laid on separately in post (TTS or a human voice-over)
